87:   bool debug_ = false;

89:   template <typename FormatContext, typename PathChar>
90:   auto write_path(const std::filesystem::path& p, FormatContext& ctx,
91:                   format_specs<Char> specs, detail::arg_ref<Char> width_ref,
92:                   const std::basic_string<PathChar>& native) const
93:       -> decltype(ctx.out()) {
94:     switch (width_ref.kind) {
95:     case detail::arg_id_kind::none:
96:       break;
97:     case detail::arg_id_kind::index:
98:       specs.width = detail::get_dynamic_spec<detail::width_checker>(
99:           detail::get_arg(ctx, width_ref.val.index), ctx.error_handler());
100:       break;
101:     case detail::arg_id_kind::name:
102:       specs.width = detail::get_dynamic_spec<detail::width_checker>(
103:           detail::get_arg(ctx, width_ref.val.name), ctx.error_handler());
104:       break;
105:     }
106: 
107:     auto out = ctx.out();
108:     auto emit = [&](basic_string_view<Char> s) {
109:       auto data = s.data();
110:       auto size = s.size();
111:       if (specs.precision >= 0 && detail::to_unsigned(specs.precision) < size)
112:         size = detail::code_point_index(s, detail::to_unsigned(specs.precision));
113:       bool is_debug_type = specs.type == presentation_type::debug;
114:       size_t width = 0;
115:       if (specs.width != 0) {
116:         if (is_debug_type)
117:           width = detail::write_escaped_string(detail::counting_iterator{}, s)
118:                       .count();
119:         else
120:           width = detail::compute_width(basic_string_view<Char>(data, size));
121:       }
122:       return detail::write_padded(
123:           out, specs, size, width,
124:           [=](detail::reserve_iterator<decltype(out)> it) {
125:             if (is_debug_type) return detail::write_escaped_string(it, s);
126:             return detail::copy_str<Char>(data, data + size, it);
127:           });
128:     };
129: 
130:     if (p.empty()) return emit(basic_string_view<Char>());
131: 
132:     if (!debug_) {
133:       if constexpr (std::is_same_v<Char, char> &&
134:                     std::is_same_v<PathChar, wchar_t>) {
135:         auto converted = detail::to_utf8<wchar_t>(
136:             native, detail::to_utf8_error_policy::replace);
137:         return emit(converted);
138:       } else {
139:         auto converted = p.string<Char>();
140:         return emit(basic_string_view<Char>(converted));
141:       }
142:     }
143: 
144:     auto quoted = basic_memory_buffer<Char>();
145:     if constexpr (std::is_same_v<Char, char> &&
146:                   std::is_same_v<PathChar, wchar_t>) {
147:       auto buf = basic_memory_buffer<wchar_t>();
148:       detail::write_escaped_string<wchar_t>(std::back_inserter(buf), native);
149:       bool valid = detail::to_utf8<wchar_t>::convert(
150:           quoted, {buf.data(), buf.size()});
151:       FMT_ASSERT(valid, "invalid utf16");
152:     } else if constexpr (std::is_same_v<Char, PathChar>) {
153:       detail::write_escaped_string<std::filesystem::path::value_type>(
154:           std::back_inserter(quoted), native);
155:     } else {
156:       detail::write_escaped_string<Char>(std::back_inserter(quoted),
157:                                          p.string<Char>());

236:       -> decltype(u.set_debug_format(set)) {
237:     u.set_debug_format(set);
238:   }
239: 
240:   template <class U>
241:   FMT_CONSTEXPR static void maybe_set_debug_format(U&, ...) {}
242: 
243:  public:
244:   template <typename ParseContext> FMT_CONSTEXPR auto parse(ParseContext& ctx) {
245:     maybe_set_debug_format(underlying_, true);
246:     return underlying_.parse(ctx);
247:   }
248: 
249:   template <typename FormatContext>
250:   auto format(std::optional<T> const& opt, FormatContext& ctx) const
251:       -> decltype(ctx.out()) {
252:     if (!opt) return detail::write<Char>(ctx.out(), none);
253: 
254:     auto out = ctx.out();
255:     out = detail::write<Char>(out, optional);
256:     ctx.advance_to(out);
257:     out = underlying_.format(*opt, ctx);
